concerns.text: Task T010 (Integration test for download pipeline) is marked as incomplete [ ] and contains 'FAILED: unspecified' markers. This task is required to verify FR-001 (USGS download) and US-1 acceptance criteria (row count N=12). Without a completed test task, the FR/SC verification chain is broken.

Tasks T013b (Ocean Masking) and T013c (Missing Data Exclusion) are marked incomplete [ ]. These directly implement FR-009 and FR-010. The absence of completed tasks for these functional requirements means the spec's data hygiene constraints cannot be satisfied.

Task T014 (Calculate left-censored anomaly) is marked incomplete [ ]. This is the core implementation of FR-003. Without this task, the primary data transformation required for US-1 and US-2 is missing.

Task T016 (Deduplication) is marked incomplete [ ]. This implements the 'Duplicate Events' edge case requirement. Missing this task leaves the data pipeline vulnerable to data leakage from revised USGS entries.
Task T017 (Generate master dataset) is marked incomplete [ ]. This is the final output of US-1. Without it, US-2 (Statistical Analysis) has no input data, breaking the entire pipeline.
Tasks T021 (KS Test), T022 (Permutation Test), and T024 (Effect Size) are marked incomplete [ ]. These implement FR-004, FR-005, and SC-001. The core statistical analysis of US-2 is missing.
Tasks T028 (Robustness), T029 (Sensitivity), and T030 (FDR) are marked incomplete [ ]. These implement FR-006, FR-007, and US-3. The robustness validation required by the spec is missing.

Task T037b (Implement code/main.py) is marked incomplete [ ]. This is the mandatory entry point for the full pipeline. Without it, the pipeline cannot be executed end-to-end as required by the Constitution Principle I.
Task T010 contains 'FAILED: unspecified' comments and is truncated. This indicates a stale or broken task definition that needs to be rewritten to be actionable, rather than just marked incomplete.
